title: Inaccurate Nutrition Info
body: On recipes where the creator gives the calorie count and nutritional info (in the comments) the Nutrition Info by RecipeSnap is inaccurate, which is a real bummer. I’m always hesitant to try AI stuff but this was super disappointing. Also the fact I can’t add pictures of a screenshot recipe is annoying, I might as well have just kept all my screenshots in my gallery.

title: Should not have to pay
body: If I want to save recipes I can just write them down and not pay you money to save them online

title: Recipe limits
body: When I downloaded the app, I was unaware that I would only be able to upload 5 recipes a week for free. It doesn’t really feel like a free app.

title: App issues
body: Nice idea and user interface but I can’t edit recipes. If I try, it just deletes what was previously there.

title: Really Good - needs more categories
body: So easy to use. Gets recipes in a snap, don’t have to save any more.

title: I LOVE this app!!
body: RecipeSnap makes it SO easy to save recipes! From YouTube videos to pictures taken of grandma’s old recipes. This app makes it SO simple to save them. I All of my recipes are in one place & eqsy to find. I can’t recommend this app enough!

title: Fantastic app
body: So awesome to be able to store all those recipes I save amongst several apps, all in one place. Incredible, so easy to use and like the option to add different categories and even add things to a shopping list. Good job to whoever created this. Only wish there was an option to pay Monthly($5) instead of all at one

title: Best Recipe Keeping App
body: By far the best recipe keeping app I’ve come across so far. Every other app I tried has struggled importing ingredient amounts accurately, but this one hasn’t!

title: Best free recipe saver app
body: Love this app! I can save all the viral tik tok recipes in a snap!

title: Love love love!!!!
body: I love this app. The import from Facebook and instagram have been amazing and it keeps the original link to the post so I can go back to it. The grocery list option is great and being able to change the serving size automatically is a lifesaver. Best app I’ve had in a long time.

title: Game changing
body: I use this at work whenever I want brainstorm

title: Finally found good app to save my recipes 🧑‍🍳
body: Easy to use and fast 👌design of the app is so simple but you have everything you need. My best friend in the kitchen 😍
